label: ABC2_hR4_166_a_b_c-001
title: Caswellsilverite (CrNaS$_{2}$, $F5_{1}$) Structure
comments:
The name caswellsilverite was not used until natural samples of the mineral were found. (Okada, 1982).
 \href{current_web_home_dir/ABC2_hR4_166_a_b_c-009}{$\alpha$-NaFeO$_{2}$}, \href{current_web_home_dir/ABC2_hR4_166_a_b_c-004}{rhombohedral delafossite, CuFeO$_{2}$}, \href{current_web_home_dir/ABC2_hR4_166_a_b_c-001}{caswellsilverite ($F5_{1}$)}, \href{current_web_home_dir/ABC2_hR4_166_a_b_c-010}{LiNiO$_{2}$} and \href{current_web_home_dir/ABC2_hR4_166_a_b_c-011}{Li$_{2}$Mn$_{3}$O$_{7}$} have the same prototype label, ABC2\_hR4\_166\_a\_b\_c.
 The difference in the internal parameter $z_{3}$ between CuFeO$_{2}$ and CrNaS$_{2}$ causes a large change in the bonding of the two crystals, so we present them as different structures. 
 The structures are generated by the same symmetry operations with different sets of parameters ({\tt --params}) specified in their corresponding CIF files. 
 Hexagonal settings of this structure can be obtained with the option {\tt --hex}.
